title: SMB session fan-out from a single workstation to multiple peer hosts
event_type: NDR/connection-summary telemetry equivalent to Zeek smb_mapping.log, aggregated per source host over a 5-minute window

callouts.explanation: Fourteen distinct SMB destinations from one workstation in a 5-minute window is the session fan-out shape described in the surrounding text; a single workstation should not normally be initiating this many concurrent SMB sessions.

Thirteen of the fourteen destinations are peer workstations rather than the file server this host normally talks to, which is the off-baseline direction the section calls out as a stronger signal than volume alone.
Admin share access (C$, ADMIN$) across most of the fanned-out sessions is consistent with a lateral-movement tool enumerating or staging on peer hosts rather than routine file access.
Comparing against this host's own 7-day baseline of a single destination is what turns the raw count into an anomaly rather than a judgment call based on the absolute number alone.

note: Illustrative and conceptual only, constructed to match the session fan-out pattern described in section 5; not a captured packet capture, NDR-tool screenshot, or product interface.
